bugs.name: quorum-off-by-one
bugs.note: Upstream 163a55f: the commit quorum is the median of the sorted match indexes rounded up, so an even cluster commits on half its nodes.

bugs.name: vote-twice
bugs.note: A node grants a second vote in a term it already voted in (the duplicate-vote check is skipped).

bugs.name: vote-ignores-log
bugs.note: The election restriction is skipped (Raft §5.4.1): votes and pre-votes go to candidates whose logs are behind.

bugs.name: accept-stale-leader
bugs.note: AppendEntries from an older term is accepted (the receiver steps down and takes its entries).

bugs.name: skip-prev-log-term
bugs.note: AppendEntries' consistency check compares only the previous index, not its term (log matching, §5.3).

bugs.name: readindex-without-barrier
bugs.note: Client: ReadIndex reads served before the leader has committed an entry in its term (§8).

bugs.name: commit-previous-term
bugs.note: The leader commits an entry of an earlier term by counting replicas (Raft Figure 8).

bugs.name: compact-past-snapshot
bugs.note: Log compaction deletes entries after the snapshot's last index.
